ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of an ocean food chain. The left side is labeled "one-celled life"; to its right is labeled "shrimplike creatures", and there is an arrow pointing from "one-celled life" to "shrimplike creatures". Farther to the right there are also arrows pointing to "small fish" and other larger fish. Reasoning: Arrows in a food chain indicate that food or energy flows from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, the arrow pointing from "one-celled life" to "shrimplike creatures" shows that shrimp-like creatures feed on one-celled life.
